details: Bitcoin dropped below $80,000 after the US economy added significantly more jobs than expected in August. This strong labor data has led investors to reassess the likelihood of further Federal Reserve interest rate hikes, negatively impacting risk-on assets like Bitcoin. The price fell by approximately $2,000 from over $81,000.
title: Bitcoin Plunges on Strong US Jobs Report, Fueling Fed Hike Concerns

details: Coinbase has filed notice registrations with the US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) to introduce single-stock perpetual futures domestically. This strategic move aims to expand Coinbase's regulated derivatives offerings in the United States and will require collaboration with both the SEC and the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC).
title: Coinbase Files with SEC for Single-Stock Perpetual Futures in US

details: Uniswap Labs has acquired an undisclosed stake in PONS, the token of a Robinhood Chain launchpad, as part of a longer-term partnership. Following this announcement, the PONS token surged over 40% in the last 24 hours, reaching a new all-time high of $0.75, driven by increased activity and investor confidence in the platform's potential.
title: Uniswap Labs Buys PONS Stake, Token Surges 40% to All-Time High

details: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) has clarified that El Salvador's recent accumulation of Bitcoin, which amounts to over 1,540 BTC since their last review, was funded by private donations rather than public resources. This confirmation addresses prior uncertainties and removes a compliance hurdle for El Salvador's $1.4 billion Extended Fund Facility program, potentially unlocking further disbursements.
title: IMF Confirms El Salvador's Bitcoin Accumulation from Private Donations
